{{Quote|It was an honor to such a great man who held the Republic in such high esteem. Cad Bane will ''pay'' for this despicable act! ''I'' will make sure of it.|Salo, on Senator Philo|<ref name="HoloNet News — A Galaxy Divided (Part 1)" />}}
'''Salo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was dedicated to [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Philo/Legends|Philo]] and was angered when he was [[Death/Legends|murdered]] during [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane's]] [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|raid]] on the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].
